message.reasoning_content: Need goods for future sales; shuttle gives 4 goods but border risk. Currently tariff 0 — no tariff, risk? Shuttle has ~25% seizure without preferential border anyway. Produce gives 3 goods safely. Round 3 action, remaining rounds 4-6 markets. I sold everything; need goods. Bribes for influence could help presidency later but bank payout matters more via rank. Money bribe to gain influence: currently influence 1, president is idx2. Vote_weight matters in law. Gaining influence to become president could help veto. But cost 5 alashi per 1 influence. Bank ~30+ alashi, shares 50/30/15 — rank matters. I have 21.25 cash + 38.75 promissory (paid in cash round 4). Rank likely high already. Getting goods is valuable: price still ~6-7 alashi/unit. Produce gives 3 goods ~20 alashi value, safe. Shuttle 4 goods ~26 alashi with 25% seizure risk. Produce safer, keeps cash.
